# dsh-wujie-canvas
DeepSeek Harness plugin for **无界画布**.
A left-sidebar canvas page for DSH. The plugin bundles the production 无界画布 front-end, starts a loopb
ack-only server for it, and proxies the local ComfyUI gateway. DSH remains the only Agent; this buil
d deliberately omits the canvas's own built-in Agent and exposes canvas operations to DSH as Agent t
y omits the canvas's own built-in Agent and exposes canvas operations to DSH as Agent tools instead.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1` or newer
- A local **无界工作台** installation with ComfyUI
- Node.js 22+ (DSH

already provides one)
- The plugin itself does **not** bundle ComfyUI, CUDA, models, or API keys
## Install
### Direct download (no plugin market)
Prebuilt tarball: https://github.com/1314521gjy/dsh-wujie-canvas/releases/latest
Web profile, install the release tarball directly:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
If your DSH build only accepts a GitHub source:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Desktop DSH: download the release archive and use the in-app plugin manager; if that build only acce
pts npm names, use the GitHub source and the profile bundle method (link the directory into `node_mo
dules` and add `dsh-wujie-canvas` to `dsh.profile.bundles`). The plugin market listing is optional a
nd does not block direct installation.
## What it does

- Adds the **无界画布** entry to DSH's left sidebar; the canvas opens in the middle
- Serves the bundled

`web/` build from a loopback-only server (default `127.0.0.1:8294`)
- Proxies the local gateway at

`http://127.0.0.1:8190` under the same origin
- Shows gateway/ComfyUI status in the tab
- When the l
ocal workbench is offline, shows a **启动本机工作台** cover; starting is explicit and uses the installed `s

tart-local.bat`. Nothing starts automatically
- Does **not** ship or start a built-in Agent. DSH's A

gent operates the canvas through:
- `wujie_canvas_status` — workbench/gateway/ComfyUI status
- `wuji
e_canvas_state` — project title, nodes (id/type/position/status/prompt/model), connections, selectio

n, viewport
- `wujie_canvas_apply_ops` — add/update/delete nodes, connect nodes, select, set viewpor

t, run generation
- The canvas page must be open on a project for the state/apply tools. The DSH wha
le widget is a separate plugin and is not this canvas's Agent.
